title: Post-import script: Exported arrays are shared across scenes and fail to persist
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.2.stable, 4.7.beta1

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 01 May 2026 15:49:22 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 595.71.05) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.36 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using an `EditorScenePostImport` script to attach a custom script and modify its `@export` array:

1. Different imported scenes appear to share the same exported array.
2. The array content is lost upon restarting the editor.

_Update:_ It works fine if the array is modified by assigning a new array instead of calling its `append()`.

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP and follow this video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2d5dde0-fe34-4a3b-b602-4260122b67d3

Note:

- In the video, I first imported and instantiated `cone.glb`, then imported and instantiated `cube.glb`. Just to be clear, this problem still exists if I import the two scenes first, and then instantiate them in the scene. It does not seem to be related to reloading the instance.

Outline:

1. Make a custom `Node3D` class that exports an array
  e.g., `@export var arr: Array[String]`
3. In the post import script, set the imported scene to that class
  e.g., `scene.set_script(MyCustomClass)`
5. Append something unique to the exported array
  e.g., `scene.arr.append("a" if get_source_file() == "res://a.glb" else "b")`
5. Import two different scenes with that post import script
6. Check the imported scene
    - Expected: the array content is unique. e.g., `["a"]` and `["b"]`
    - Actual: the array content seems shared. e.g., `["a", "b"]` and `["a", "b"]`
6. Restart the editor and check again
    - Expected: the array content is preserved
    - Actual: the array content is cleared

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-4.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27422297/test-4.zip)
